svg.title: Visual and sensory representation
svg.desc: Through which form can a person perceive meaning? Separate the perceptual carrier, translation between carriers, and adaptations that change how the meaning can be grasped. Source illustration: A notebook presents a chart and its generated description together; the library also supports alternative output placements.

text.tspan: Through which form can a person perceive

physical action, including translations and adaptations that make it
